title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Coleus no Yume
content:
Another one of those “why wasn’t this included in the main season canon”. But not quite.

I’m actually glad it wasn’t, as the quality was not quite on par with what was presented in season one.

This is a three episode story that happens between the events of season one and two, were Rimuru and his goons find themselves involved in the affairs of a yet other collective of people. They tried to push the whole “infiltrate with disguises so that our identities are kept hidden” but the charm of the underdog that early season one had going did not really shine. Maybe it is just thattired.

One thing for sure this tool from the parent show is the good action sequences. I’m glad they did not cheap up on those because it makes a huge deal of what makes Slime the Anime it is.

The character rooster was not the strongest, let me tell ya. Not only are the new characters very filler-pronounced but the main cast chosen to play here are also very overused and I’d rather have other lesser screen time characters play a part. Like whatever happened to the whole Gobta underdog plotline?

Overall: 6.88/10.
